svg.title: Docker Architecture — animated: pull, run, ps, build, push, rm
svg.text: pull → run → ps → build → push → delete from the GUI (watch the commands move between Client, Server and Registry)
Docker Desktop uses the same Docker API as the CLI
① docker pull nginx — the Daemon downloads the image layers from the Registry
② docker run — the Daemon creates a container from the image and starts it
③ docker ps — the Daemon lists the running containers back to the Client
④ docker build — the Daemon builds a new image (myapp) from your Dockerfile
⑤ docker push — the Daemon uploads the image layers to the Registry for others to pull
⑥ Docker Desktop (GUI) — click the trash icon: same Docker API, the container is deleted
